title: CGFM-Nav: Cognitive Graph-Field Memory for Semantic-Guided Lifelong Multimodal Embodied Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to reason over accumulated observations while continuously exploring unseen regions. However, existing environment representations often struggle to jointly support explicit semantic memory and continuous exploration guidance. To address this challenge, we propose Cognitive Graph-Field Memory (CGFM), a persistent multimodal scene representation that couples explicit relational memory with continuous spatial intuition. CGFM organizes objects, spatial relations, and visual observations into a multimodal scene graph, enabling target retrieval and long-horizon reasoning across navigation tasks. When no reliable target match is identified, graph-based evidence is projected into a goal-conditioned semantic-frontier field to guide exploration toward semantically promising frontiers and regions. translated_title: CGFM-Nav：面向语义引导的终身多模态具身导航的认知图-场记忆
translated_abstract: 视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在持续探索未见区域的同时，对累积的观测信息进行推理。然而，现有的环境表示往往难以同时支持显式的语义记忆和持续的探索引导。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了认知图-场记忆（CGFM），这是一种持久的多模态场景表示，将显式的关系记忆与连续的空间直觉相结合。CGFM将物体、空间关系和视觉观测组织为多模态场景图，从而支持跨导航任务的目标检索和长程推理。当未找到可靠的目标匹配时，基于图的证据会被投影到一个目标条件化的语义前沿场中，引导探索朝向语义上更有前景的前沿区域和空间。基于CGFM，我们提出了CGFM-Nav，一个基于基础模型的终身多模态具身导航框架……
tldr: 提出认知图-场记忆（CGFM）及导航框架CGFM-Nav，通过将多模态场景图与目标条件化语义前沿场耦合，同时支持显式语义记忆和持续探索引导，实现语义引导的终身多模态具身导航。
en_tdlr: Proposes Cognitive Graph-Field Memory (CGFM) and the CGFM-Nav framework, which couples a multimodal scene graph with a goal-conditioned semantic-frontier field to jointly support explicit semantic memory and continuous exploration guidance for semantic-guided lifelong multimodal embodied navigation.
